capabilities: Toggle a full-screen flow mode from the command palette or a hotkey
Dim already-written text to a configurable opacity
Seal finished words so they cannot be edited, deleted, or undone
Center the current line with typewriter scrolling
Show a session word count and toggle properties, inline title, and Esc behaviour in settings
extras: Desktop only; the full-screen behaviour does not exist on Obsidian mobile. Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Built with Claude Code.
intentEvidence: This plugin is an independent reimplementation for Obsidian.
motivation: The author reimplemented the mechanic from the Flow Writer app because it 'deserved to write into a real note instead of a scratch buffer you have to copy out of'.
problem: Obsidian's normal editor makes it easy to keep editing and polishing earlier text while drafting, which interrupts flow and stalls unfinished drafts.

relations.evidence: This plugin is an independent reimplementation for Obsidian.

summary: Full-screen distraction-free writing mode that dims already-written text and seals finished words so a draft can only move forward.
